stories.summary: Sign in with the platform's Cognito credentials through the builder's public /sign-in and /auth/callback routes, land on a builds page that shows the signed-in author and an empty build list, and own the /sign-in page's three-value error contract (sign_in_incomplete, session_required, session_expired) that BSB-18-PENDING-3's denials use, refusing non-members, incorrect passwords and unverifiable callbacks without a session or users row

Keep one stable builder account per Cognito subject, visible on the account page and reused on later sign-ins, in the builder's own users table, with no platform database client, connection or credential anywhere in the deployment

Own the single per-request authorization middleware for protected authoring pages and APIs, with /sign-in and /auth/callback exempt as public routes, refusing anonymous and expired-session requests before any builder data is returned, sending pages to the sign-in entry point with BSB-18-PENDING-1's error codes and messages, and denying a member removed from the skill-builders group within one hour with JSON 401 and 403 for APIs
